what_this_lane_delivers.capability: The canonical contract for a parlay ticket: leg and ticket shape, American/decimal odds conversion, ticket pricing, validation, leg and ticket outcome resolution, settled pricing over surviving legs, order-independent ticket identity, and per-ticket statistics contribution.
what_this_lane_delivers.why_the_contract_is_the_right_first_laye: Every later layer - API validation, persistence, grading, statistics - has to agree on what a parlay is, how it is priced and when it is settled. Landing those rules once, in a package with no I/O, means the API cannot re-derive them differently from the UI, and the statistics layer cannot count a ticket differently from the grader.
what_it_explicitly_does_not_claim: No Smart Form UI for adding, removing, reordering or reviewing legs.
No API endpoint or request validation for a multi-leg ticket.
No persistence, no ticket-level attribution in the database, no migration.
No claim that the pipeline can currently grade or settle a parlay. Production game_results stops at 2026-06-30; the semantics are defined here, the result data does not exist.
No teasers and no round robins. Tracked as UTV2-1908 and UTV2-1909 with their own acceptance criteria.

mutation_battery.method: Each mutation applied alone to the source, the suite run, the file restored from a copy taken before the battery. Baseline re-confirmed after the final revert. Run with no concurrent suite, because a mutation in packages/contracts is visible to every other suite that imports it.

mutations.mutation: deriveParlayTicketIdentity loses its .sort(), so leg order becomes significant
deriveParlayTicketIdentity drops the stake, so two different stakes collide
deriveParlayTicketIdentity drops each leg's price, so a re-priced leg collides
parlayStatContribution reports records: legCount instead of 1
a pending ticket reports records: 1 instead of contributing nothing
a win prices the full ticket (priceParlay) rather than the survivors (priceSettledParlay)

mutation_battery.why_M9_and_M11_matter_most: M9 is how a parlay silently inflates a capper's record by its own leg count. M11 is how a parlay that pushed a leg is paid at a price the operator never had. Both are statistics-truth defects that no type check would catch.
mutation_battery.rewritten_control: The pricing test originally asserted the literal 3.6446280991735537, which no-loss-of-precision correctly refuses. It now computes const exact = (1 + 100/110) ** 2 and compares within 1e-12, plus the exact American conversion +264. +264 rather than +263 is the control: rounding each leg to 1.91 first produces +263, so the assertion fails if the implementation ever rounds per leg.

queries.label: no multi-leg submission exists anywhere today - the baseline this contract will later change
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT submission_id FROM picks WHERE submission_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 1) t
queries.what_it_establishes: picks.submission_id is an existing FK that structurally permits 1:N, and it has never been used that way. Every submission maps to exactly one pick. A parlay is therefore genuinely new behaviour rather than an undocumented existing shape, and the persistence lane has a no-DDL route available to it.

coverage_gap.status: OPEN, and stated rather than papered over
coverage_gap.finding: There is no runtime path to exercise. This lane adds pure functions to @unit-talk/contracts, a package with no I/O, no DB and no HTTP, and nothing yet calls them.
why_it_could_not_be_closed_inside_this_l: file_scope_lock is pinned at lane-start and admits exactly four paths - package.json, packages/contracts/src/index.ts, ticket.ts and ticket.test.ts. No apps/api, no apps/smart-form, no packages/db, no supabase/migrations.
A runtime proof of a parlay requires an API endpoint, a persistence layer and a ticket row. All three are separate lanes by lane type as well as by file scope.
Production game_results stops at 2026-06-30, so even with persistence there is no result data to settle a parlay against. The only exit is the provider key, which is reserved.
coverage_gap.why_it_is_not_a_reason_to_hold_the_lane: The contract is additive and unreferenced: no existing code path changes behaviour, which is why the staging battery is green unchanged. Landing it lets the persistence, API and UI lanes build against one agreed definition instead of three.
coverage_gap.disposition: Recorded as a dependency on UTV2-1912, which enumerates the persistence, API and UI lanes and the measured blocker on each.
